description: What the suite of the MCP server's host must notice (docs/MCP-SERVER.md "The host", P6 ext-18): the client's id and task, the gate locked to its scope (no autonomous, no Full Access, 90 s), approval_timeout, the single-writer rule (another MCP write, the primary agent, the lock file, checked again after the answer), the manager of each client (hooks, external policy, its task, the limit of clients, a workspace switch, close), the tag of its approvals, and the wiring in server.mjs and hub.mjs (state, decide route, provider, scope, close, the Hub's busy rule).

mutations.name: H1-client-id-case
mutations.what: the client's id keeps the case of its name (two ids for one client)

mutations.name: H2-client-id-unbounded
mutations.what: the client's id is not cut at 64 characters

mutations.name: H3-task-id-random
mutations.what: the task of a client is a new UUID at every start

mutations.name: H4-timeout-not-applied
mutations.what: the gate of a client waits longer than it says

mutations.name: H5-mode-setter-open
mutations.what: a plain assignment sets any mode (autonomous)

patches.old: set: (value) => { const next = alias(value); if (!modes.includes(next)) refuse(
patches.new: set: (value) => { const next = alias(value); if (false) refuse(

mutations.name: H6-policy-setter-open
mutations.what: a plain assignment sets any execution policy (full-access)

mutations.name: H8-configure-policy-check
mutations.what: configure() lets a request with an unknown policy change the mode first

mutations.name: H9-configure-mode-check
mutations.what: configure() does not check the mode itself
mutations.equivalent: PermissionGate.configure assigns the mode before the policy, and the accessor of H5 refuses the same modes with the same code before anything else is set or saved, so no request behaves differently; the check only gives the refusal before the base method runs.

mutations.name: H10-write-scope-autonomous
mutations.what: the write scope allows autonomous

mutations.name: H11-read-scope-review
mutations.what: the read scope can be raised to Review

mutations.name: H12-write-scope-readonly
mutations.what: the write scope starts in Read Only (nothing can ever be approved)

patches.old: const DEFAULT_MODE = Object.freeze({ verify: 'readonly', read: 'readonly', write: 'review' });
patches.new: const DEFAULT_MODE = Object.freeze({ verify: 'readonly', read: 'readonly', write: 'readonly' });

mutations.name: H13-gate-not-interactive
mutations.what: the gate of a client has nobody to ask (every question refused at once)

mutations.name: H14-no-expiry-result
mutations.what: an expired request is a plain denial, not approval_timeout

mutations.name: H15-no-call-context
mutations.what: the call runs outside its AsyncLocalStorage record (the gate's events are not tied to it)

patches.old: return this.#calls.run(record, () => this.#run(slot, spec, args, signal, record));
patches.new: return this.#run(slot, spec, args, signal, record);

mutations.name: H16-reads-are-writes
mutations.what: every call counts as a write (a read waits for the agent)

mutations.name: H17-writes-are-reads
mutations.what: only a tool marked write counts as one (edit_file is asked while the agent works)

mutations.name: H18-no-writer-slot
mutations.what: a second MCP write does not wait for the first

mutations.name: H19-writer-never-released
mutations.what: the writer's place is never given back

mutations.name: H20-primary-not-checked
mutations.what: the primary agent's work does not stop a write

mutations.name: H21-primary-fails-open
mutations.what: a primaryState that throws counts as idle

patches.old: try { primary = await this.primaryState(); } catch { primary = { busy: true }; }
patches.new: try { primary = await this.primaryState(); } catch { primary = { busy: false }; }

mutations.name: H22-lock-not-checked
mutations.what: the workspace lock file does not stop a write

mutations.name: H23-no-recheck-after-answer
mutations.what: an approval given after the agent started still runs the write

patches.old: if (busy) throw Object.assign(new Error(busy.message), { code: 'workspace_busy', busy });
patches.new: if (false) throw Object.assign(new Error(busy.message), { code: 'workspace_busy', busy });

mutations.name: H24-hooks-not-shared
mutations.what: a client's manager runs without the owner's hooks

mutations.name: H25-no-external-servers
mutations.what: a client's manager never offers the owner's external servers (an external tool of the host cannot run)

mutations.name: H26-task-not-acquired
mutations.what: the manager of a client holds no task (no session can be made)

mutations.name: H27-client-limit-off-by-one
mutations.what: a ninth client gets a manager

mutations.name: H28-workspace-switch-ignored
mutations.what: a client keeps its manager on the old workspace after the owner chose another one

mutations.name: H29-close-keeps-requests
mutations.what: close() leaves a client's request waiting until it runs out

mutations.name: H30-tag-without-prefix
mutations.what: a request is tagged with the bare client id

mutations.name: H31-decide-misses
mutations.what: the host's decide() finds no request

patches.old: if (!slot.retired && slot.gate.state().pending.some((item) => item.id === id)) return slot.gate.decide(id, approved);

mutations.name: H32-unknown-local-target
mutations.what: a tool that names no local tool is accepted

mutations.name: H33-external-without-schema
mutations.what: an external tool without its own inputSchema is accepted

patches.old: if (spec.inputSchema === null || typeof spec.inputSchema !== 'object' || spec.inputSchema.type !== 'object') throw

mutations.name: S1-client-not-passed
mutations.what: the listener does not hand the request's clientInfo to the provider (every client is one)

mutations.name: W1-state-not-merged
mutations.what: /api/state does not carry the clients' requests

mutations.name: W2-decide-not-routed
mutations.what: the decide route does not reach the host

mutations.name: W3-hub-no-host-tools
mutations.what: the Hub's host serves no tool

mutations.name: W4-hub-write-scope
mutations.what: the Hub's host runs in the write scope

mutations.name: W5-hub-host-not-closed
mutations.what: the Hub's stop does not close the host

mutations.name: W6-hub-busy-no-task
mutations.what: the Hub's busy rule ignores the manager's task

mutations.name: W7-hub-busy-no-agent
mutations.what: the Hub's busy rule ignores an active agent task

mutations.name: W8-hub-busy-no-merge
mutations.what: the Hub's busy rule ignores a coding worker being merged
